cohort: 42 consecutive cases of umbilical cord prolapse (UCP) out of 13,292 deliveries over a 5-year period at Aminu Kano Teaching Hospital, Kano, in North-Western Nigeria
finding: The incidence of umbilical cord prolapse was 0.32% (1 in 316 deliveries), with a perinatal mortality of 45.2%.
mod_finding: 25 (59.2%) of the 42 umbilical cord prolapse patients and 1.41% of the 1,771 emergency c-sections were performed due to cord prolapse.
